title: Fines
description: Fines and tolls for your cars, matched to the driver at the time

help.title: About traffic fines
help.overview: Enter a fine when the notice arrives. The booking that had the car at that time is found by itself, with its main driver; if none, the staff transfer that had it.

sections.title: Choose one way
items: Name the driver: send the driver letter to the authority; the driver pays, and the customer is charged only the handling fee.
Charge the customer: the fine and the handling fee go on the booking. After the return they get their own invoice; a saved card is charged, otherwise the customer pays from the booking link.
Record payment when the company pays the authority. With no booking to charge, the fine is kept as the company's cost.
Dispute a fine you contest; annul it if the authority drops it. Staff are warned a week before an unpaid fine is due.
